planned_profile.method: The figure is a schematic plan. Elapsed times were read from marker positions on the 0–70 minute axis and rounded to the nearest minute. Altitudes are nominal chamber-equivalent values. Planned ramp rates are reported in Methods. The figure and table do not provide measured attendance-level pressure or delivered gas histories.

trainee_post_change_followup.locator: Nakdimon and Ben-Ari 2022, Discussion, printed p. 815 (PDF p. 5)
trainee_post_change_followup.note: The authors report zero trainee DCS events in the 18 months following several changes. Exposure counts, calendar dates, staff outcomes, clinical follow-up schedule and overlap with the 2015–2022 cohort are unavailable. Descent rate was unchanged, and pulse oximetry was added throughout trainee hypoxia exposure. Concurrent changes prevent attributing the result to any single measure.

records.locator: Methods and Results, p. 353; limitations, pp. 355–356
records.note: The 2015–2022 report covers 272 chamber sessions and 11 cases in 2,279 trainees and instructors as printed. It describes 30–45 minutes of preoxygenation and two main training protocols. The report provides no dated link to the earlier narrative 18-month trainee follow-up. No new counts were entered from this article.
